on_screen_text.text: For most of our country's history, the Bible was found in every classroom in the nation. Yet in many schools today, students are instead indoctrinated with anti-religious propaganda, and some are even punished for their religious beliefs and very, very strongly punished. It's ridiculous. Joining us this morning is Hannah Allen from Honey Grove, Texas. A few years ago, Hannah organized a group of her classmates to pray for an injured peer. The school principal declared that Hannah's generous act of love was prohibited from taking place in front of the other students. To support students like Hannah, I'm pleased to announce this morning that the Department of Education will soon issue new guidance protecting the right to prayer in our public schools, and it's total protection.
Protecting the Right to Prayer in Schools

spoken_summary: Donald Trump claims that for most of American history, the Bible was in every classroom, but now students are indoctrinated with "anti-religious propaganda" and punished for their beliefs. He shares the story of a student named Hannah Allen from Texas, who he says was prohibited by her principal from organizing a prayer for an injured classmate. In response, Trump announces that the Department of Education will issue new guidance protecting the right to prayer in public schools, which he calls "total protection." His announcement is met with applause.
audio_music: The video consists of clear speech from Donald Trump. At the end, there is the sound of an audience applauding.
editing_pacing: The video is a static talking-head shot of Donald Trump speaking, with captions appearing on screen. It concludes with a brief montage of B-roll footage.
central_claim: Donald Trump is taking action to protect the right of Christian students to pray in public schools, a right he frames as being under attack.
intended_effect: To assure religious and conservative viewers that Donald Trump is a champion for their values and is actively working to protect religious freedom in the United States.
